name: ScrollVelocityProgress
description: Scroll progress indicator that tracks position and modulates bar thickness and luminance intensity based on scroll velocity in horizontal or vertical orientation.
a11yNotes: Renders role='progressbar' with aria-valuemin={0}, aria-valuemax={100}, and aria-valuenow={progress} and disables velocity thickness modulation under prefers-reduced-motion.

propsApi.name: velocity
propsApi.description: Scroll speed factor (0 to 4) modulating thickness and glow.
